name: Apartmenthaus Seeresidenz
beschreibung: Apartmenthaus Seeresidenz is located in Thiersee, a charming small community in the Tyrolean Unterland. The holiday apartments offer views of Lake Thiersee and are set in a peaceful location on the edge of the village. Guests can enjoy simple, well-maintained accommodation with self-catering amenities. The lake is within walking distance, and the scenic surroundings invite visitors to enjoy relaxing walks and scenic hikes. The apartment house is ideal for travelers looking for straightforward accommodation with a relaxed rural atmosphere.
